meaning: 1 = throwing-side action of a delivered stone visible; 0 = no such action; null = setup/release boundary uncertain from the source-only sheet

ambiguous_notes.S08: Yellow player has a stone in a short shot before a separate wide view and later throwing-side shot; exact delivery boundary is unclear.

limitations: Single-agent source-only visual review of three sampled frames per detected shot.
Neither independent throw ground truth nor release-time labels.
A cut scanner can miss edits, and a shot can change phase internally.
